content.value: A quiz corisists of 10 multiple-choice questions. Each question has 5 possible answers, only one of which is correct. Pat plans to guess the answer to each question. Find the probability that Pat gets-

(i) One answer correct, (ii) All 10 answer correct, (iii) Find the probability that Pat fails the quiz. A marks is considered a failure if it is less than 50%, (iv) Find the probability that Pat passes the quiz. (v) Find the probability that Pat gets one answer correct.
